NBA_AddCarry.source: import R1SamplerAddDigits set_option autoImplicit false namespace AspisR1.NBA_AddCarry open SamplerAddDigits abbrev P : Nat := 2147483647 def Frame (digit carry out next : Nat) : Prop := out=(if digit+carry≥P then digit+carry-P else digit+carry) ∧ next=(if digit+carry≥P then 1 else 0) theorem step {digit carry out next : Nat} (hd : digit rfl | cons digit carry out next final xs ys hd hc frame tail ih => have value := step hd hc frame simp only [addDigits,←value.1,←value.2.1,ih] theorem unique {xs left right : List Nat} {carry a b : Nat} (lt : Trace xs carry left a) (rt : Trace xs carry right b) : left=right ∧ a=b := by have eqn := (source lt).symm.trans (source rt) exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst eqn,congrArg Prod.snd eqn⟩ theorem construct (xs : List Nat) (carry : Nat) (hc : carry≤257) (canonical : ∀ d∈xs,d exact ⟨[],carry,.nil carry⟩ | cons d xs ih => let out := if d+carry≥P then d+carry-P else d+carry let next := if d+carry≥P then 1 else 0 have hd := canonical d (by simp) have frame : Frame d carry out next := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ have good := step hd hc frame obtain ⟨ys,final,tail⟩ := ih next (by omega) (fun d h => canonical d (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr h)) exact ⟨out::ys,final,.cons d carry out next final xs ys hd hc frame tail⟩ #print axioms step #print axioms source #print axioms unique #print axioms construct end AspisR1.NBA_AddCarry

import NBA_AddCarry
import IndexedCandidateAddSmallWrapperNatModelV3
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBA_AddPair
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1

theorem source (digits : Digits) (carry : U32) (canonical : Canonical digits)
    (small : carry.val≤257) (out : List Nat) (final : Nat)
    (trace : NBA_AddCarry.Trace (values digits) carry.val out final) :
    ∃ outCarry : U32, ∃ outDigits : Digits,
      AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p digits carry=
        ok (outCarry != 0#u32,outDigits) ∧ values outDigits=out ∧ outCarry.val=final := by
  obtain ⟨c,d,call,value,cv⟩ :=
    ExtractedIndexedAddSmallWrapperNatModelV1.add_small_base_p_refines_addDigits digits carry canonical small
  have step := NBA_AddCarry.source trace
  rw [step] at value cv
  exact ⟨c,d,call,value,cv⟩

#print axioms source
end AspisR1.NBA_AddPair

NBL_AddNative.source:
import NBA_AddPair
import LPk_Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBL_AddNative
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1

/-- Complete native add-small carrier from the checked per-digit trace.
The output array/carry are ports of that trace, not supplied model-call results. -/
theorem source (digits : Digits) (carry : U32) (canonical : Canonical digits)
    (small : carry.val≤257) (out : Digits) (last : U32)
    (trace : NBA_AddCarry.Trace (values digits) carry.val (values out) last.val) :
    AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p digits carry=
      ok (last != 0#u32,out) := by
  obtain ⟨c,d,call,value,cv⟩ := NBA_AddPair.source digits carry canonical small (values out) last.val trace
  have ce : c=last := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq cv
  have de : d=out := Subtype.ext (LPk_Result.values_injective _ _ value)
  simpa only [ce,de] using call

/-- Canonicality of the produced array is derived after every carry pass. -/
theorem canonical (digits : Digits) (carry : U32) (out : Digits) (last : U32)
    (trace : NBA_AddCarry.Trace (values digits) carry.val (values out) last.val) :
    Canonical out := by
  have same := congrArg Prod.fst (NBA_AddCarry.source trace)
  dsimp only [Prod.fst] at same
  intro j hj
  change (out.val[j]'(by simpa [out.property] using hj)).val < 2147483647
  have member : (out.val[j]'(by simpa [out.property] using hj)).val ∈ values out := by
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_,List.getElem_mem _,rfl⟩
  have all := SamplerAddDigits.addDigits_output_digits_lt 2147483647 carry.val (values digits) (by decide)
  rw [same] at all
  exact all _ member

#print axioms source
#print axioms canonical
end AspisR1.NBL_AddNative

NBA_ArrayEight.source:
import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBA_ArrayEight
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem read {α : Type} (a : Array α 8#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<8) :
    Array.index_usize a i=ok (a.val[i.val]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega)) := by
  obtain ⟨v,call,value⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec a i (by simpa only [Array.length,a.property,show (8#usize).val=8 by rfl] using hi))
  rw [value] at call
  exact call

theorem literal {α : Type} (a : Array α 8#usize) :
    a.val=[a.val[0]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[1]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[2]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[3]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[4]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[5]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[6]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega),
      a.val[7]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega)] := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · change a.val.length=8
    exact a.property
  · intro i hi hj
    have bound : i<8 := by have := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at this; omega
    have cases : i=0 ∨ i=1 ∨ i=2 ∨ i=3 ∨ i=4 ∨ i=5 ∨ i=6 ∨ i=7 := by omega
    rcases cases with h|h|h|h|h|h|h|h <;> subst i <;> rfl

#print axioms read
#print axioms literal
end AspisR1.NBA_ArrayEight

NBL_SecondCarry.source:
import NBL_AddNative
import R1SamplerAddBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBL_SecondCarry
open SamplerAddDigits SamplerAddBridge

/-- General end-around-carry safety, independent of a concrete numeral or
recurrence evaluation. A positive first carry makes the next increment fit. -/
theorem natural {p a : Nat} (hp : 0<p) (xs : List Nat)
    (canonical : ∀ d∈xs,d<p) (small : a<p^xs.length)
    (wrapped : 0<(addDigits p a xs).2) :
    (addDigits p 1 (addDigits p a xs).1).2=0 := by
  have bounded := digitsValue_lt_pow hp xs canonical
  have first := addDigits_mod_div hp a xs
  have ge : p^xs.length≤digitsValue p xs+a := by
    by_contra h
    have zero : (digitsValue p xs+a)/p^xs.length=0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [first.2,zero] at wrapped
    omega
  have lt : digitsValue p xs+a<2*p^xs.length := by omega
  have remainder : (digitsValue p xs+a)%p^xs.length=digitsValue p xs+a-p^xs.length := by
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod ge,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have next := (addDigits_mod_div hp 1 (addDigits p a xs).1).2
  rw [addDigits_length,first.1,remainder] at next
  rw [next]
  exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)

#print axioms natural
end AspisR1.NBL_SecondCarry

import LPk_Induction set_option autoImplicit false namespace AspisR1.NBL_PassConstruct open SamplerMachineBounds SamplerWord SamplerWordPass SamplerRepeatedPass theorem pass (r : UInt64) (xs : List UInt32) (good : r.toNat exact ⟨r,[],.nil r⟩ | cons d ds ih => let step := machineStep r d let r1 := UInt64.ofNat step.2.toNat have r1value : r1.toNat=step.2.toNat := uint32_to_uint64_toNat step.2 have relation := LPk_Step.machine_step r d good have bounded : r1.toNat

exact ⟨[],xs,.nil xs⟩ | succ n ih => obtain ⟨r,qs,first⟩ := pass 0 xs P_pos obtain ⟨ds,out,tail⟩ := ih qs exact ⟨r.toNat::ds,out,.cons first tail⟩ theorem pass_length {r out : UInt64} {xs qs : List UInt32} (trace : LPk_Induction.Pass r xs out qs) : qs.length=xs.length := by induction trace with | nil => rfl | cons step tail ih => simpa only [List.length_cons] using congrArg Nat.succ ih theorem digits_length {n : Nat} {xs out : List UInt32} {ds : List Nat} (trace : LPk_Induction.Digits n xs ds out) : ds.length=n ∧ out.length=xs.length := by induction trace with | nil => exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | cons first tail ih => exact ⟨congrArg Nat.succ ih.1,ih.2.trans (pass_length first)⟩ #print axioms pass #print axioms digits #print axioms pass_length #print axioms digits_length end AspisR1.NBL_PassConstruct
